title: Measure the character length of failbench
rationale: Length checks gate truncation and payload limits; an unstable count can cause silent data loss in ingestion and formatting code that relies on the figure.

prompt.content: You are a precise assistant. Answer with the number only, with no other text.
How many characters are in the word failbench? Count every character. Answer with the number only.

notes: Repeats=3 and all three must pass. Deterministic: static prompt, temperature 0, one integer answer. Expected value 9: failbench is f-a-i-l-b-e-n-c-h, exactly nine characters. Brittleness: a spelled-out numeral fails the numeric unit, and a model that counts syllables or splits the word fails by design.
